messages:
Alex Reed (AE): Heads-up 1 DeepStream sent an RFI. They want a compact capability matrix, explicit POC pricing for a 2-week trial, HSM/BYOK wording, and a short note on autoscale/burst behavior for EU-only tenancy. Can eng/security/pricing help?

Mina Park (SSE): I can pull the matrix. Clarifying Qs: POC targets? concurrency/embeds/context?

Alex Reed (AE): POC target: 210 concurrent gen streams, 45k embeds/day. Primary context 16k, occasional 32k. EU-only tenancy required. BYOK asked for Private.

Omar Ruiz (Eng-ML): Draft matrix snippet for RFI table (use conservative numbers):

Omar Ruiz (Eng-ML): ```
Capability | Hosted API | Dedicated (reserved) | Private (VPC / BYOK / HSM)
--- | --- | --- | ---
Context support | up to 32k (model dep) | up to 32k | up to 32k
Gen p50 (16k) | 150-240 ms | 95-150 ms | 100-170 ms
Gen p95 (16k) | 520-900 ms | 320-560 ms | 340-600 ms
Gen p50 (32k) | 430-680 ms | 300-460 ms | 320-500 ms
Embed p50 | 35-85 ms | 18-45 ms | 20-50 ms
Concurrent handling | bursty to 100s | reserved pools 100-1k | customer pools configurable
Autoscale | hosted autoscale with cold-starts | pre-warmed reserved nodes | customer-controlled scaling + pre-warm
Caching | automatic prefix/KV caching | tuned local cache | local cache + VPC KV
Quantization | bf16 / int8 options | int8 recommended | custom quant + kernel tuning
KMS / HSM | Redwood-managed KMS | customer KMS integ | customer HSM (add-on), BYOK supported
SLA | standard | SLA-backed tiers | enterprise SLA
```

Jules Becker (Security): Approved HSM/BYOK line for RFI: "Customer-managed HSM or HSM-backed KMS is supported for Private deployments. Keys remain in customer-controlled hardware or vetted KMS; Redwood control plane never receives plaintext keys. Attestation and audit artifacts available under NDA." Legal will gate SOC2/ISO attachments.

Mina Park (SSE): Ops blurb to include: "Requests prefer reserved pools first. For EU-only tenancy, fallback options are limited to EU regions: (1) queue/backpressure; (2) route to EU-hosted compatible pool if tenant not pinned; (3) route to quantized variant per policy; (4) fail closed if strict tenancy and no capacity. Dedicated pools can be pre-warmed to reduce cold-start p95."

pricing-bot: Preliminary 2-week POC estimates uploaded: hosted (unoptimized) ~$26,500, optimized w/ caching/quant ~$9,800; small dedicated 2-week reservation ~$38,000; Private EU + HSM 2-week POC starting ~$70,000 + integration fee ~$11,000. Final numbers pending finance confirmation.

Alex Reed (AE): Good. Can we aim to have the RFI bundle (matrix + 3 short Q&A bullets + HSM wording + pricing rows + ops blurb) ready to send by EOD tomorrow? Mina, take the draft matrix and assemble. Omar, add the calibration note for occasional 32k runs. Jules, finalize security lines.

Omar Ruiz (Eng-ML): Calibration note: "32k runs increase latency and memory pressure; recommend a short perf calibration (2-4 hour sample) during POC to verify p95 targets and adjust batch/kv cache. Private deployments can enable custom kernel paths to improve 32k int8 perf."

Jules Becker (Security): I'll upload the security checklist and flag legal gating items.

Mina Park (SSE): I'll post the assembled RFI draft and CSV cost breakdown by 15:30 CET.

Alex Reed (AE): Thanks team :thumbsup: — will review and send once finance/legal cleared.
